reply_text:
I saved the draft mail to Marcus Lindqvist (mlindqvist@pemberline.com) in Anselm's drafts and replied to Anselm in their DM. Nothing has been sent; Anselm can review it and send it.

- **What the draft says:** the subject is "Tansley Parcel: proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives $1,752 a seat as the proposed 2027 rate from Pree and says Anselm approved sharing it. It also asks Marcus to keep it internal and check with Pree or the deal desk before quoting it anywhere else.
- **Why no further approval was needed:** Tansley Parcel is Pree's account, not Marcus's, so the rate needed sign-off from Anselm or June before going to Marcus. Anselm is the CFO and gave that approval in this message. Marcus has a pemberline.com address, so Ruth Calloway's approval for outside mail didn't apply.
- **The figure isn't confirmed:** I couldn't find $1,752 anywhere I can see. There are no files under the Tansley account folder, and the brain search found nothing. The draft uses the number exactly as Anselm gave it, and I told Anselm that in my reply.
